verdict.rationale: Devin is documented as a conversational interface. Users direct it in plain language through the web UI, by tagging it in Slack/Teams threads, or with natural-language prompts to the CLI, and a hands-on user confirms steering it by typing a few lines. Missing for 10: evidence that it reliably follows corrective natural-language instructions, since one hands-on report says it couldn't undo extraneous changes when asked.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Devin is designed to be a conversational user interface
Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!
Tagging Devin on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you're discussing with coworkers
devin -- check out this code and suggest a feasible, helpful feature
just checking every 10-15 minutes and typing a few lines or restarting session
